spec.data_source: Read-only core/v1 Endpoints and Service LIST inventories from the same selected cluster and namespace scope, with projected rows and cluster/namespace/UID provenance bound to the native response.
spec.predicate: NOT_APPLICABLE for unmarked or custom-managed Endpoints, or without a unique controlling v1 Service owner; PASS when the same-namespace, same-name Service has the exact owner UID; FAIL only when a complete Service inventory has no Service by that name; UNKNOWN for partial inventory, malformed owner/identity, or current Service UID disagreement.
spec.title: Controller-managed Endpoints Service owner resolves in its namespace
spec.description: Reviews only legacy Endpoints marked as Kubernetes endpoint-controller managed with one controlling v1 Service owner of the same name and a nonempty UID. A missing Service is a dangling structural reference, not evidence that the Endpoints has no traffic or custom consumers.
spec.remediation_hint: Confirm controller ownership and intended consumers before removing a dangling legacy Endpoints object.
